description.value: Koh-I-Noor is a long-running North Indian and Nepalese restaurant in downtown Kamloops, known for its tandoor oven cooking, lunch buffet, and one of the city's notable views. The kitchen cooks with traditional clay-oven (tandoor) techniques and sources halal meat, offering a wide menu that spans curries, tikkas, momos, and fresh naan. Touring cyclists will find a full sit-down dining room with banquet capacity and a range of dietary accommodations including gluten-free, vegan, and no-MSG dishes.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and provides strong evidence: the business is actively operating as a full sit-down Indian and Nepalese restaurant at 550 Columbia Street West, Kamloops. The phone number (236) 425-4540 and address are confirmed on the contact page. The website explicitly mentions gluten-free, vegan, and halal options, and an 'Order Today' phone prompt implies phone-in takeout orders. No bike-specific amenities (racks, pump, Wi-Fi, charging) are mentioned anywhere on the site.
concerns: OSM name is 'Koh-I-Noor Indian' but the website uses 'Koh-i-noor Indian & Nepalese Restaurant' — the Nepalese cuisine component is not reflected in the OSM name.
OSM record has no phone number; phone (236) 425-4540 sourced from website only, so contact_confirmed.phone is null.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active, publicly accessible restaurant in downtown Kamloops with a confirmed website, phone, and address. A clear and useful stop for touring cyclists seeking a full sit-down meal with dietary options.
enrichment_extras.notes: Catering and banquet services available for groups of 40–50; contact via phone for details.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Website states: 'We serve gluten free, no MSG, vegan, and Halal meat dishes.' Menu also flags individual vegetarian items

wow_evidence: long-running North Indian and Nepalese restaurant in downtown Kamloops, known for its tandoor oven cooking, lunch buffet
